## Problem Statement

Is your feature request related to a problem? Describe what's missing or
frustrating, e.g. "There is no way to configure a custom page replacement
policy for..."

## Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. If this touches
core architecture (memory manager, page table, retrieval, policies), please
reference the relevant section of [docs/architecture.md](../../docs/architecture.md).

## Alternatives Considered

A description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Research Context (optional)

If this proposal is grounded in a paper, benchmark, or prior art, link it
here.

## Additional Context

Add any other context, diagrams, or examples about the feature request here.
